message:
Finally, we're getting to this ridiculous conversation. So, let's get straight to it: I'm all for drug legalization. I mean, it's not like we haven't tried the "war on drugs" and seen how well that's worked out. Complete fail. Billions wasted, lives ruined, and what do we have to show for it? A bunch of outdated, ineffective legislation that's more concerned with shoving morality down our throats than actually solving the problem.

You're probably one of the folks who thinks the current system is working just fine, right? You think we should just keep throwing people in jail for having a few joints, and maybe the problem will magically go away? Give me a break. The only thing that's going to "go away" is our ability to have a rational discussion, thanks to your close-mindedness.

Let's get real here. The majority of people already use or have used drugs. It's time we join the rest of the world and treat this like the public health issue it is, not a crime. You can't just "just say no" to something when it's everywhere and people are dying because of it. So, are you going to be one of the enlightened ones, or are you going to stick with the status quo and pretend like we're not all secretly stoned?

runs.justification: The message caricatures the opponent's position as 'thinking the current system is working just fine' and 'pretending like we're not all secretly stoned'. It uses dismissive language ('Give me a break', 'You can't just...') and mocks their stance.
